भ्रे(भ्ले)ष् €1 U. (भ्रेषति-ते, भ्लेषति-ते)
—1 To go, move.
—2 To fall, totter, trip, slip.
—3 To fear.
—4 To be angry.

—1 Moving, motion.
—2 Tottering, wavering, slipping.
—3 Deviation, swerving, aberration.
—4 Deviation from rectitude, trespass, sin.
